sources.title: Public maintenance guidance
sources.excerpt: Review material when its governing facts or operating conditions change.

options.label: Use a fixed interval
consequences: May schedule work when no material facts changed.

options.label: Use an event trigger
consequences: Ties review to a material change.
Requires a named owner to notice the trigger.

human_escalations.recommendation: Use an event trigger when ownership is explicit and reliable.
